program_name: iPhone 12 and iPhone 12 Pro Service Program for No Sound Issues
coverage_summary: iPhone 12 and 12 Pro with no sound from the earpiece; no longer on Apple's list and nearly all phones are past the 3-year window
index_note: The program page is still reachable, but the program is no longer listed on support.apple.com/service-programs (checked 2026-09-29).
symptom: Receiver module does not emit sound when making or receiving calls
remedy: Service free of charge by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider (AASP)
mandatory_conditions: Device must be an iPhone 12 or iPhone 12 Pro (excludes iPhone 12 mini and iPhone 12 Pro Max)
Device must exhibit receiver failure symptom
Device will be examined prior to any service to verify eligibility
Service must be obtained within three years after the first retail sale of the unit
exclusions_and_caveats: Any damage that impairs the ability to complete the repair (such as a cracked screen) must be resolved prior to service, which may incur a fee
Program does not extend standard warranty coverage period
Service may be restricted to original country or region of purchase
The three-year window runs from the first retail sale of the unit, which may be earlier than your purchase date if the device was bought used or refurbished
